raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / VILLA SINGOLA CON PISCINA VICINO AL MARE A JESOLO FOR SALE · DETACHED HOUSE Villa Singola con Piscina vicino al Mare a Jesolo PIAZZA MARCONI - DRAGO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE Price on request Photos (43) Floor plans (0) 1 / 43 FLOOR AREA 150 m² BEDROOMS 4 BATHROOMS 3 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo! Located in Jesolo, just 200 meters from the sea, stands a single-family villa built in 2020 that redefines the concept of living in Jesolo. It is not just a house but an ecosystem of design and technology. On the ground floor, there is a bright open space that combines kitchen, dining room, and living area seamlessly connecting to the private outdoor area: a garden featuring an elegant pool and a porch designed for enjoying summer without boundaries between indoor and outdoor spaces. Every detail is managed by home automation and heated by state-of-the-art underfloor heating systems. The sleeping area develops over two upper levels, ensuring privacy and versatility: On the first floor, we find a master bedroom alongside a double room; both communicate through a spacious shared terrace. In front of the double room lies a third single bedroom, all served by a master bathroom and practical storage space. The second and final floor is entirely dedicated to the Master Suite: A loft-style environment with walk-in closet, dedicated bathroom, and private sun terrace—ideal for those seeking an intimate panoramic retreat. Privacy is total, especially as you ascend floors: while the first level hosts three bedrooms served by large terraces, the top floor becomes true sanctuary—a unique Master Suite complete with walk-in closet, dedicated bathroom ,and private sun terrace. The undeniable value of this property is underscored by its CasaClima certification: an independent public protocol (EU Directive 2010/31/EU) guaranteeing exceptional construction quality and energy sustainability for clients—a seal of transparency protecting your investment over time. Bold design meets technological soul with the sea just steps away. Don't wait for the future: come live it now!
